summary: All 3 user requests verified end-to-end on preview URL. BACKEND: 12/12 pytest cases pass (/app/backend/tests/test_admissions_phone.py). GET /api/admissions/check correctly returns normalized upper-case admission_no + {allowed, registered} flags for unknown/in-list-unregistered/in-list-registered/lowercase+whitespace cases; empty/whitespace => 400. GET /api/students/by-phone/{phone} returns 200 with full student when phone matches phone_no OR whatsapp_no, accepts '+91 <10digit>' and '91<10digit>' (last 10 digits), 404 'No registration found for this mobile number' for unknown, 400 'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number' for <10 digits. FRONTEND (390x844): Register inline validation works - typing NOPE999 shows admission-error 'Admission number not found in college list. Please contact the admin.' with red border (rgb(230,57,70)); typing seeded QAUI01 shows admission-ok 'Admission number verified' in green; typing already-registered TT9001 shows admission-error 'This admission number is already registered. Open My Pass to view your pass.'; submitting with bad admission shows form-feedback with same copy and triggers scroll-to-top. My Pass empty state (fresh localStorage) shows BOTH phone-lookup card (phone-input + find-pass-btn) AND no-pass 'New Here?' card (go-register-btn). Unknown phone (9876543210) => phone-error 'No registration found for this mobile number'; 5-digit input => 'Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number'; registered phone 9000000001 => pass-card renders student 'Test Student' admission TT9001; pass persists across hard reload; forget-pass-btn returns to lookup card. pass-card contains testID pass-poster visible with non-zero bounds (356x320) above TAAL TARANG header; ENTRY PASS badge, Confirmed badge, avatar initials/photo, Admission/Class/Father/Type/Date/Time/Reg details all render. REGRESSION: Full register flow (seed admission via POST /api/admin/admissions -> fill all fields -> submit) succeeds, auto-navigates to My Pass within ~1.2s, pass-card displays with uploaded poster hero.jpg + student details. All seeded data (QAUI01, QAUI02, and per-run UIR* + REG*) cleaned up successfully (DELETE 200).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py normalize_admission (strip+upper) is applied consistently in /register, /admissions/check, /admin/admissions POST and DELETE — good.
/api/students/by-phone/{phone} correctly strips non-digits and takes last 10 so '+91 9xxxxxxxxx' and '919xxxxxxxxx' both resolve to the stored 10-digit field. Matches phone_no OR whatsapp_no via $or.

register.tsx uses a 500ms debounce on checkAdmission; cancels in-flight requests via a `cancelled` flag. isAdmissionError regex (/admission number/i) matches both 'not found' and 'already registered' copies so submit-time errors also scroll to top and flip the field to red.

passes.tsx POSTER=require('../../assets/images/hero.jpg') is embedded in PassCard above the TAAL TARANG header with LinearGradient scrim + ENTRY PASS pill — exactly as specced. Poster uses aspectRatio 1024/923 so it never collapses to 0 height.
Phone lookup saves pass via saveMyPass(s), so reload persistence works without extra wiring. forget-pass-btn calls clearMyPass + setStudent(null), restoring the lookup card without route change.
